build_sql: SELECT "Destination" AS dest, CASE WHEN "Profit Margin" < 0.3976434082191792 THEN 'low' ELSE 'normal' END AS grp, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN "Profit" < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_loss, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS s_qty, COUNT("Sales Quantity") AS c_qty, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") AS s_rev, COUNT("Total Logistics Revenue") AS c_rev, SUM("Profit") AS s_profit, COUNT("Profit") AS c_profit, SUM("List Price Revenue") AS s_list, COUNT("List Price Revenue") AS c_list, SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue") AS s_vas, COUNT("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue") AS c_vas, SUM("Discount Amount") AS s_disc, COUNT("Discount Amount") AS c_disc, SUM("Discount Amount"/"List Price Revenue") AS s_disc_rate, COUNT("Discount Amount"/"List Price Revenue") AS c_disc_rate, SUM("Freight Cost") AS s_freight, COUNT("Freight Cost") AS c_freight, SUM("Warehousing Cost") AS s_wh, COUNT("Warehousing Cost") AS c_wh, SUM("Other Operating Costs") AS s_other, COUNT("Other Operating Costs") AS c_other, SUM("Total Logistics Cost") AS s_cost, COUNT("Total Logistics Cost") AS c_cost, SUM("Total Logistics Cost"/"Sales Quantity") AS s_cpu, COUNT("Total Logistics Cost"/"Sales Quantity") AS c_cpu, SUM("Customer Age") AS s_age, COUNT("Customer Age") AS c_age, SUM("Profit Margin") AS s_margin, COUNT("Profit Margin") AS c_margin FROM sheet1 GROUP BY dest, grp

rewritten_queries.Q4: SELECT grp, SUM(n) AS n, SUM(s_qty) * 1.0 / SUM(c_qty) AS avg_qty, SUM(s_rev) * 1.0 / SUM(c_rev) AS avg_rev, SUM(s_rev) AS sum_rev, SUM(s_profit) AS sum_profit, SUM(s_profit) * 1.0 / SUM(c_profit) AS avg_profit, SUM(s_list) * 1.0 / SUM(c_list) AS avg_list, SUM(s_vas) * 1.0 / SUM(c_vas) AS avg_vas, SUM(s_disc) * 1.0 / SUM(c_disc) AS avg_disc, SUM(s_disc_rate) * 1.0 / SUM(c_disc_rate) AS avg_disc_rate, SUM(s_freight) * 1.0 / SUM(c_freight) AS avg_freight, SUM(s_wh) * 1.0 / SUM(c_wh) AS avg_wh, SUM(s_other) * 1.0 / SUM(c_other) AS avg_other, SUM(s_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(c_cost) AS avg_cost, SUM(s_cpu) * 1.0 / SUM(c_cpu) AS cost_per_unit, SUM(s_age) * 1.0 / SUM(c_age) AS avg_age, SUM(n_loss) AS n_loss FROM reuse_candidate GROUP BY grp
rewritten_queries.Q6: SELECT dest, SUM(n) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN grp='low' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS n_low, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN grp='low' THEN n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(n)*100,2) AS low_pct, ROUND(SUM(s_qty) * 1.0 / SUM(c_qty),1) AS avg_qty, ROUND(SUM(s_freight) * 1.0 / SUM(c_freight),1) AS avg_freight, ROUND(SUM(s_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(c_cost),1) AS avg_cost FROM reuse_candidate GROUP BY dest ORDER BY low_pct DESC
rewritten_queries.Q8: SELECT SUBSTR(dest,1,INSTR(dest,'-')-1) AS region, SUM(n) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN grp='low' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS n_low, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN grp='low' THEN n ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(n)*100,2) AS low_pct, ROUND(SUM(s_qty) * 1.0 / SUM(c_qty),1) AS avg_qty, ROUND(SUM(s_freight) * 1.0 / SUM(c_freight),1) AS avg_freight, ROUND(SUM(s_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(c_cost),1) AS avg_cost, ROUND(SUM(s_margin) * 1.0 / SUM(c_margin),3) AS avg_margin FROM reuse_candidate GROUP BY region ORDER BY low_pct DESC
